sourceTitle: Thick & Crunchy Peppermint Mocha Ice Cream Shake
sourceText:
Thick & Crunchy Peppermint Mocha Ice Cream Shake
By: sonia gupta
Published: Saturday, March 26, 2011 - 7:51pm

Ingredients




6 scoops Vanilla Ice Cream:
8 Peppermint candies: (or peppermint extract: 2 drops)
1/4 cup Milk:
1 teaspoon Mocha Latte Powder:
White Chocolate chips: few (& optional)

Preparation

1 Finely crush the peppermint candies in a blender to make powder. 2 Add vanilla ice cream or  any favorite flavor and milk. 3 Give it a quick churn in the mixer, till frothy. 4 Add a Tsp of Mocha Latte Powder. 5 Can add chocolate chips in the shake to get a little chocolaty flavor with some mouthfeel. 6 Give our mix a quick churn in the blender & we are almost done. 7 Sprinkle some mocha latte on top of the glass. 8 And you are all set.

About


find more at http://www.mycreativeflavors.com/2011/03/thick-crunchy-peppermint-mocha-ice.html
